name: audio-locked-paper-theatre
title_zh: 先过前40秒验证关，再让旁白锁死整条纸剧场时间线
tagline_zh: 旁白定稿前，纸剧场素材再多也不开工。前40秒先过审，时长翻倍就翻倍质检，3:4/4:3封面原生出，交付包齐活。
tagline_en: No asset build-out until the first 40s pass. Duration-scaled QA, native 3:4/4:3 covers, release package—all keyed.
desc_en: Plan, validate, and deliver narration-locked editorial paper-collage explainers of 60 seconds or longer, with no hard upper duration limit. Use when the final voice track must control a fixed paper-theatre timeline with many independent AI assets, deterministic captions and semantic marks, a first-40-second proof gate, duration-scaled whole-film QA, native 3:4/4:3 covers, and a release package. Do
why_zh: 把「旁白优先」做成硬门禁：先验证前40秒叙事成立，才允许铺开全片资产，避免整条时间线被一段废旁白拖垮。
why_en: Narration is a hard gate, not a suggestion: fail the first 40 seconds and nothing else proceeds. Built for long-form paper.
limit_zh: 只认纸剧场拼贴风格，且旁白须为最终音轨；不接纯动画、实拍或自由时间轴。素材需自带分层，无AI资产编排能力者勿入。
limit_en: Paper-collage style only, final voice track required. No cel animation, live action, or free timelines. Layered assets mandatory; no auto-layout.
title_en: A 40-second proof gate before narration locks your.
